question: The Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) is an example of the _______ industry.
solution:
The correct answer is __**public sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) is a **public sector undertaking (PSU)** in India.
 
• SAIL is one of the largest steel-making companies in India and one of the **Maharatnas of India's Central Public Sector Enterprises**.
 
• It was established in 1973 and operates under the **Ministry of Steel, Government of India**.
 
• SAIL owns and operates **five integrated steel plants** at Bhilai, Rourkela, Durgapur, Bokaro, and Burnpur (Asansol), and three special steel plants at Salem, Durgapur, and Bhadravati.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)**

 
 
• PSUs are government-owned corporations or state-owned enterprises created by the government to undertake commercial activities on behalf of the government.
 
• These entities are either wholly or partially owned by the government and are typically involved in industries considered crucial for the country's economy.
 
 
 
• **Maharatna Status**
 
 
• This status is granted to select CPSEs to empower them to expand operations and emerge as global giants.
 
• Companies with Maharatna status have greater autonomy compared to other PSUs in terms of investment decisions, mergers, and acquisitions.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Steel**
 
 
• This is the apex body responsible for formulating policies and strategies for the growth of the steel industry in India.
 
• The ministry ensures coordination among various stakeholders, including public and private sector steel companies.
 
 
 
• **Integrated Steel Plants**
 
 
• These are large-scale industrial setups that carry out all processes from raw material processing to finished steel production.
 
• They include various stages such as coke production, sintering, iron making, steel making, and rolling.
